newsitem.title: ITALY: FIAT EURO JULY CAR SHARE STEADY AT 13 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FIAT EURO JULY CAR SHARE STEADY AT 13 PCT.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat saw its share of the European car market hold steady at 13 percent in July in line with its June market share and up from 11.9 percent in July 1996, car industry sources said on Friday.

In the seven month period January-July, the group which also takes in car marques Alfa Romeo and Lancia saw its share at 12.6 percent from 11.8 percent in the same period of 1996. This confirms Fiat in second place in the European car industry behind German group Volkswagen.
According to data from European producers group ACEA, Volkswagen's market share in June was 18.8 percent.
